rapport_notes: Very patient through a lot of customer-driven negotiation (date change, truck count, mover count) without pushback or frustration.
process_discipline_notes: None of the four core differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, communication) were mentioned anywhere in this call, even though a full quote was given and the move was booked.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do we have before we proceed, do we have any concerns or any important things if you wanted to answer during this call?" -- asked in the same breath as the quid pro quo.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we're not locked in for six hours if ever you still have time to repair [prepare] then you can be able to do that as well" -- self-prep tip and pay-less-if-faster both touched near the close.

top_strength: Successfully re-scoped the job in real time (partial-house move, not a full 3,500 sqft home) to right-size the crew/truck count instead of over-quoting off square footage alone.
coaching_note: Booked the move (Saturday, $772-$1,549) without ever mentioning a single core differentiator -- no damage coverage, no Meet Your Mover, no On-Time Guarantee -- worth double-checking this doesn't become a pattern on quick/negotiated calls.
